events.title: Sandra Selig: Figure of 8 Exhibition
events.description: An exhibition by Australian artist Sandra Selig focusing on her intricate light and sound installations that challenge perception. Expected to be a quiet, contemplative atmosphere in a leading local contemporary art space.

events.title: Mas{a/i}r . مسار . مسیر The Map of Nearness Exhibition
events.description: A multi-disciplinary exhibition exploring themes of migration, geography, and memory through contemporary art. Hosted by Outer Space, a grassroots gallery known for supporting emerging and experimental artists.

events.title: Permaculture Workshop: Life hacks for saving money and living well
events.description: A hands-on session at a community-managed city farm focused on practical, sustainable living techniques. You will learn actionable systems for self-sufficiency that emphasize permaculture design principles.
